name: Alcadon Group AB (publ)
summary: Alcadon Group AB (publ) engages in the data and telecommunications business in Sweden. The company offers passive products, including installation materials, such as fiber and copper cables, sockets, and connectors; testing tools and instruments; and active products, which consist of switches, converters, SFP/XPFs, and wireless products, as well as technical support and training services. It also provides commercial real estate networks, such as structured cable systems for offices, industries, and municipal/county councils; MPO systems for data centers, server halls, and co-location; and active communication equipment comprising switches, routers, and wireless. In addition, the company's residential networks include new and ROT production, communication solutions for home, and solutions for electricity. Further, it offers fiber net/FTTx comprising area and urban networks for the railway, energy companies, municipalities, and cities; broadband networks for communities, bylaws, and associations; and act as network operator for ISPs and telecommunication operators. Additionally, the company provides network design, troubleshooting, fiber welds, and rental services, as well as measuring instrument copper/fiber and blow fiber equipment. It distributes and wholesales its products to system integrators, and companies that own or operate data and telecommunication networks. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
